rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CIII Of the space of Life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The chapter asks whether the native is likely to live long, under the historical astrological system.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed CIII / editorial CIV, a new source unit; historical prognostication not modern survival science.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: before any particular Direction of five Hylegiacall places
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly requires checking general chart strength before specific longevity directions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One rule prerequisite rather than a patient diagnosis.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: degree ascending extremely afflicted
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An afflicted rising degree is offered as evidence against long life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No reproducible threshold for 'extremely afflicted' on this page.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the Geniture afflicted
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An afflicted lord of the nativity is also an unfavorable factor.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Significator assignment depends on preceding source rules.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun or Moon, Light of time, extremely afflicted
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Condition of the Sun, Moon and luminary of the time is examined for longevity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Diurnal/nocturnal status matters, not interchangeable.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: these argue no long life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He infers shortened lifespan from combinations of the unfavorable chart conditions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historic unsupported survival estimate, not medical evidence.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: in vaine to frame long Directions
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says long directions are not worth computing when the chart has unfavorable longevity indicators.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Could create selection bias by excluding short-survival predictions from other checks.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: examine Nativities of Parents of Children
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He recommends checking the parents' natal charts before predicting a child's life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Parents' birth records or charts are not supplied.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of Children in Parents charts strong
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Assess how strong the children's significators are in parental charts.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Additional potentially unconstrained chart feature set.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: goodnesse of fruit depends upon temperament roots
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He compares children's health to fruits depending on roots.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Period metaphor, not evidence for a physiological mechanism.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Children whose Parents unfortunate Significators dye small sicknesse
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly asserts that children of parents with unfortunate significators may die from relatively minor illness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Potentially alarming and scientifically unsupported, source-only.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: First consider degree ascending
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: First inspect the child's natal Ascendant degree as a signifier of life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Horoscope geometry unverified.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fortunate when in terms or signe
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Ascendant is considered favorable in good planetary terms or signs.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-defined dignities, not physical risk predictors.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: or in sextile or trine benevolent Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A benefic sextile or trine to rising degree is said to be favorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source uses specific angular aspects without a confirmed orb here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: infortune visits ascending degree by square or opposition
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A malefic at/near the Ascendant or in square/opposition is said to be unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conditional angular distance and nature, no current medical interpretation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many violent fixed Starres Lord eighth arife ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Fixed stars characterized as eighth-house ruler's nature are included as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No stars or numerical orbs individually identified.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fortunate Child may live past Infancy
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A favorable Ascendant is interpreted as helping a child survive infancy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent survival data.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: afflicted he hardly escapes infancy
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An unfavorable Ascendant is interpreted as poor infant-survival prospects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Retrospective historical claim, not a prognosis.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Secondly Lord of ascendant Essentially strong
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Ascendant ruler's essential dignity is another favorable prerequisite.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source uses essential dignity categories.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: free from Combustion Retrogradation affliction swift motion
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly requires the Ascendant lord free from combustion, retrogradation and adverse aspects, and swift.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conjunct conditions, not separate successful patient cases.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: not impeded by Lords eighth twelfth fourth sixth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Unimpeded relations to rulers of the eighth, twelfth, fourth or sixth houses are treated as favorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Topic/house classifications are historical.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: it argues ... Child or Native may live long
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The favorable Ascendant-lord description crosses the physical PDF559→560 seam and concludes that it is a long-life indicator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One continuous judgment, not a second independent case.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of Ascendant Combust ... short life so saith Jo. Schoner
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He reports Schoner's opposite rule: combustion of the Ascendant ruler or an afflicted rising degree indicates short life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical attribution, independently unaudited; no clinical validation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Thirdly regard Sun Moon Sun if day Moon if night
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He prioritizes Sun in a day chart and Moon in a night chart.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Explicit diurnal/nocturnal fork.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: strong well dignified in good house favorable aspect Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A well-dignified luminary in a suitable house with a benefic aspect is claimed favorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conditional symbolic classification.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: it argues Native may long live
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He interprets the favorable luminary as a long-life indicator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent event proof.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Moon partill conjunction Infortunes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Exact conjunction between luminaries and malefics is described as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-specific conjunction/orb semantics.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: full Moon born perish excess moisture
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly asserts full-Moon births can involve too much moisture and reduced longevity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical humoral and lunar-phase medical claim unsupported by modern evidence.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: change of Moon want humidity too much drinesse
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He asserts newborns near new Moon may suffer from deficient moisture or excessive dryness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not a clinical conclusion.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: weakest bodies small sickly at change Moon
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims the weakest, smallest and sickliest infants are typically born at lunar change.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent childbirth cohort supplied.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Ancients say Luminaries partill conjunction or opposition
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He attributes to earlier authorities a special full/new Moon conjunction/opposition exception.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different branch from his initial adverse lunar-phase claim.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter or Venus in Ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Under the ancients' exception, Jupiter or Venus ascending is taken as benefic.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Specific condition; do not generalize to all lunar phases.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Child shall live active successful but not attain old age
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He alleges such a child can survive and be active/successful yet not reach old age.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Mixed favorable/unfavorable source result; preserve both.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortune in Ascendant instead of Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Replacing the benefic with a malefic in that configuration reverses the judgment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conditional context essential.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: judge death or no long life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The ancient rule infers death or shortened life with an ascendant malefic.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-only mortality assertion.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lights in any angle malignant aspect infortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Affliction of one or both luminaries in angular houses by malefic aspects is treated as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Many possible placements and aspects.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun conjunction Mars or opposition Saturn
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source treats Sun–Mars conjunction and Sun–Saturn opposition as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The printed Sun symbol and malefic combinations are distinct.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon conjunction Saturn or opposition Mars
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source treats Moon–Saturn conjunction and Moon–Mars opposition as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not interchangeable with solar conditions.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lights afflicted plus combust Lord Ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Combined malefic luminary contact and combustion of Ascendant ruler is claimed to indicate shorter life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Compound threshold without observed outcomes.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Many Planets sixth eighth twelfth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Concentration in the sixth, eighth or twelfth houses is described as unfavorable for longevity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No empirical medical risk linkage supplied.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Ascendant without good aspect Lights or Horoscope
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He also examines whether the Ascendant ruler has no favorable aspect to luminaries or rising point.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Meaning depends on chosen favorable aspect type and orb.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortunes in Ascendant ... short life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The condition involving many planets or malefics in the ascendant continues across original PDF560→561 and is interpreted as a short-life indicator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One continuous warning; do not count a separate empirical instance across the seam.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Moon in cadent houses
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly adds cadent placements of both luminaries as another unfavorable ingredient.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Branch of a compound rather than a universal rule with calibrated risk.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn and Mars in first and seventh opposition
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn and Mars opposing across the first and seventh houses are an unfavorable configuration.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The source particularly mentions Saturn in the first house.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: All Planets under the earth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly treats all planets below the earth as an adverse condition in the combined longevity assessment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not sufficient as a modern survival indicator.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neither Sun Moon Lord Asc essentially dignified
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He considers lack of essential dignity in both luminaries and the ascendant ruler unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Additional set of potentially unfixed thresholds.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: not good aspect with Jupiter or Venus
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A missing favorable aspect to Jupiter/Venus is another adverse qualifier.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Favorable aspect kind and orb not specified here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Asc going to conjunction Lord eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He treats the ascendant lord applying to the eighth ruler as a negative branch.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source demands additional ill testimonies.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: North South Nodes in same degree with Mars Saturn in fourth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lunar nodes sharing a degree with Mars or Saturn in the fourth are described as indicating short life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Very specific source conjunction conditional, not clinical proof.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in Aries above earth diurnal
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars is considered particularly destructive when in Aries, above the horizon, in a day chart.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Compound period chart condition.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in Capricorn above earth nocturnal
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn is assigned comparable negative role in Capricorn, above the horizon, in a night chart.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Diurnal/nocturnal fork, not interchangeable with Mars.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Some affirm Moon conjunction Mars Ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly reports that some astrologers call a Moon–Mars conjunction in rising place a bad birth.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Attribution to others, not independently documented outcomes.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Saturn unfortunately eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Likewise a Moon–Saturn combination in the eighth is characterized as unfavorable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate condition from Moon–Mars Ascendant.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: They live not long Saturn Mars Moon conjunction
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims shortened life when Saturn, Mars and Moon are conjoined.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical human longevity belief.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ascending degree afflicted Mars in eighth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He gives an additional short-life configuration involving rising degree affliction and Mars in the eighth.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not actual observed child deaths.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon fourth square opposition Saturn Mars mother difficult labour
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims Moon in fourth square/opposite a malefic relates to difficult labor for the mother.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical obstetric speculation, no diagnostic validity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Child lives not long Moon fourth affliction
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He separately claims poor infant survival under that supposed maternal-labor configuration.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-only, no medical use.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Luminaries separate from Fortune apply malevolent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The lights separating from a benefic and applying to a malefic are treated as dangerous.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A temporal application/separation sequence, not static aspect alone.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: danger at time luminary by measure direction reaches malefic
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He suggests timing risk when the directed luminary encounters the malefic body/aspect.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Implied event-timing technique, not independently demonstrated.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: carefully observe all Significators
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He demands considering all significators rather than deciding from one factor.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical source qualification.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: not pronounce death rashly
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly expressly warns against declaring a death outcome rashly.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Essential mitigating instruction; does not make the method safe or accurate.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon besieged between bodies Mars and Sun
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He interprets Moon's besiegement by Mars and Sun as a short-life indicator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One final source statement without independent data.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CIV Of the Prorogator of Life called Hylech Hyleg Apheta
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A distinct chapter starts below the printed horizontal divider with historical terms for the Hyleg, or life prorogator.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Next printed CIV / editorial CV, a separate high-stakes longevity method.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: and of the killing or interficient Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next chapter announces a traditional method for identifying a death-associated planet.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Unverified historical prediction claims, no actual medical risk estimate.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Chaldean planet or place Heaven directed ... life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next chapter defines the named life significator as a directed planet or chart place used to judge life.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The method's substantive algorithm extends beyond this navigation window.
